All unrelated tenant/company settings and business tables unchanged.
Exact current receipt recovery does not update last_used_at, epoch, receipt, scope or unknown context.
All after-write errors must roll back the whole tenant transaction, not return an error-shaped successful callback.

policyDecision: Target forced-reset refusal explicitly approved by root; improvement in web authority/recovery, not asserted historical equality.
notes: The two allowed outcomes for a blocked concurrent transaction are explicit, not a silent automatic retry. A later deliberate retry uses original ID/body.
Only current receipt is retained; reusing an older no-longer-retained ID with current epoch cannot be distinguished from a fresh operation.
Physical-row snapshot equality means no committed mutation; PostgreSQL transaction internals/WAL are not claimed absent.
